scope: Actual check.py, every report row and its summary, full input outline/assessment/archive audit, six nearest AUTHOR files and the relevant primary paper sections were reviewed. Existing result arithmetic and payload hashes were checked without executing scientific code.
apparatus_and_derivation: The material basis, complete neutral-cell termination, co-moving shorted electrodes, reference-area normalization and conventional current entering the upper terminal fix both sign and geometry. The small-amplitude then quasistatic limits select the relaxed linear current coefficient.

The specified w is the complete homogeneous zero-macroscopic-field free energy. Its internal Hessian is (K+4|x|^2)I+8xx^T with eigenvalues at least K>0, so the radial solution and independent three-component stationarity solve select the same unique stable constitutive state.

For J=det F, the laboratory polarization is P=-F s/J. Differentiating it gives exactly the supplied dP expression and instantaneous area projection -J(F^-T e3).dP. The source is a mathematically correct improper polarization susceptibility interpreted as the measured terminal coefficient.

The unit-upper-electrode weighting potential is R3/N: it is harmonic for a homogeneous affine slab, zero/one at the material faces and compatible with lateral periodicity. Thus the induced upper charge is -sum(q_i R3_i/N). Each complete neutral pair contributes s3/N; summing N layers gives positive upper screening charge s3 per reference cell area, and conventional current entering that electrode is ds3/dlambda.

With M=F^-1 G, source minus physical response is (M s)3-tr(M)s3. This is the transported-charge versus polarization-density distinction. It is not an error in the supplied constitutive differentiation.

The full F box has positive determinant. Simple component bounds give |h|/K<.278; adding this to c+s0 keeps each charge strictly inside its selected cell. No coordinate wrapping, branch jump or unstable internal root is needed.

The macroscopic-thickness idealization, complete neutral cells, absent independent surface law and prescribed zero-field material constitutive energy close the surface/backaction issue. The model is an explicit effective insulator, not a quantitative claim for an unspecified real crystal.

reference_review.independent_elements: A separate vector root solves internal equilibrium at four perturbed F states. Charge- and first-moment-preserving deposition constructs actual planar source charges; a grounded banded Poisson solve gives upper charge; fourth-order finite differences then give the response.
reference_review.shared_inputs: The specified material free energy and affine electrostatic geometry are necessarily common. The reference neither reuses ds3 nor inserts the oracle current correction.
reference_review.geometry: Lateral periodic modes with nonzero wavevector integrate to zero terminal charge. The constant affine Poisson metric cancels against the total-flux conversion; the 1D solve is an exact reduction for this integrated readout.
reference_review.qualification: The Dirichlet weighting solution is linear, so preserving charge and first moment makes this terminal charge essentially mesh-exact. Tiny mesh/thickness changes should be read as consistency and roundoff checks, not an independently established convergence rate for a general 3D electrostatic solver.

calibration_review.shared_subset: F=diag(1,1,l), G=diag(0,0,+/-1) cancels the moving-face contribution exactly at every allowed K. Longitudinal response remains nonzero and nonlinear in the constitutive state.
calibration_review.global_identification: x3 solves K*x3+4*x3^3=.35*(l^2-1). The positive rate response is .7*l/(K+12*x3^2). Differentiating its denominator in K gives (K-12*x3^2)/(K+12*x3^2)>0, since |x3|<=.08904/.8 and12*x3^2<.149<K. Each positive calibration setting is strictly decreasing in K, so it identifies K globally.
calibration_review.qualification: Global injectivity gives a unique zero of the noiseless objective; it does not by itself prove a single stationary point for every noisy multi-setting objective. No instrument sigma/private truth or model-failure rate is established by this prototype.

qualifications: The145-state validation is not every corner of the six-dimensional F box. The41-K signal sweep is bounded evidence rather than a uniform interval error theorem.
Transverse-y sign-changing source cases remain in the report but are not proposed for scoring; positive transverse-x cases already have large ordinary signals.

The rigid-rotation test uses G outside the proposed upper-triangular input subset. It is a valid extended-constitutive identity and explicitly unscored, not a public-domain or scored zero-response claim.

public_outline_review.necessary_facts: Effective charges/cell termination, total zero-field free energy, homogeneous mechanical control, full internal relaxation, co-moving equal-potential electrodes, bulk limit and current sign/reference-area units are necessary apparatus data.
public_outline_review.future_package: Keep the ordinary neutral replacement instruction, unfinished public fit and private completed controls; validate the retained full public domain, both current signs, finite noise/parameter margins and actual local verifier runtime before any model evaluation.

primary_source_review.title: Berry-phase theory of proper piezoelectric response
primary_source_review.author: David Vanderbilt
primary_source_review.access: Primary five-page PDF text, especially sectionsIII.A-C and equations12-16,24-25, read in this review.
primary_source_review.support: The paper distinguishes polarization derivatives from measured current under deformation, discusses shorted electrodes, gives longitudinal equality and relates polarization to termination-dependent surface charge. The classical nonlinear internal energy and parameter choices here are independently specified constructions.
primary_source_review.publisher_access_note: The DOI endpoint returned an internal browser error; approval relies on the accessible primary manuscript, not an asserted publisher full-text read.

overlap_review.finding: Different from bulk piezoelectric wave electrostatic elimination, terminal tunneling-noise capacitor weights, initial mechanical stress, persistent actuator channels, Frank boundary work and coherent-alloy compatibility. It shares broad geometric/readout themes; no claim of an unrelated universal principle is needed.

later_trial_classification.intended_physical_failure: The agent retains the completed laboratory polarization-density susceptibility as current entering moving electrodes despite the stated transported-charge measurement.
later_trial_classification.mathematical_or_mixed_failure: The agent identifies moving-electrode total charge/current correctly, but drops a product-rule term, uses a wrong inverse/transpose, charge sign, determinant derivative or normalization, or rejects a correct derivation because of a broken scratch calculation. A low score alone does not establish physical failure.

decision: Approved as a bounded prototype suitable for root-authorized task construction; not a frozen task or empirical difficulty result.
